verdict.rationale: Sierra is an agent-building SaaS platform, so offering an official MCP server is a fair question to ask. However, the pack has no evidence of a documented, customer-facing MCP server that external agents can connect to. The only MCP reference is an engineering blog about an internal gateway that connects Sierra's own AI agents to company tools, which is an adjacent internal capability rather than an official MCP server. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs also returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
